description: Give ChatGPT access to your community's vibe. Vibewatch is community intelligence for web3 teams: it reads your community across Discord, Telegram, X, and more, scores the vibe, surfaces daily insights, and writes weekly reports. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Vibewatch organization through the hosted Vibewatch MCP server — sentiment overview, daily trend, message search, daily insights, weekly reports, market context, and the public Stacks ecosystem index, all read-only. Sign in with your Vibewatch account.

defaultPrompt: What's the vibe in my community this week?
Why did our community sentiment dip last week?
Summarize our latest weekly Vibewatch report.
